account_grants_quantity.name: account_grants_quantity
account_grants_quantity.value:
("account_grants"."kind" = 'pro_months' and "account_grants"."quantity" between 1 and 12
        and "account_grants"."granted_from" is not null and "account_grants"."granted_until" is not null)
      or ("account_grants"."kind" = 'invoice_credits' and "account_grants"."quantity" between 1 and 500)

subscription_payments_manual.name: subscription_payments_manual
subscription_payments_manual.value:
"subscription_payments"."provider" <> 'manual' or ("subscription_payments"."status" = 'succeeded'
        and "subscription_payments"."method" is not null and "subscription_payments"."external_reference" is not null
        and "subscription_payments"."paid_at" is not null and "subscription_payments"."recorded_by" is not null)

business_payment_instructions_details_pr.name: business_payment_instructions_details_present
business_payment_instructions_details_pr.value:
("business_payment_instructions"."method" = 'bank_transfer' and "business_payment_instructions"."instructions" is not null)
        or ("business_payment_instructions"."method" <> 'bank_transfer' and "business_payment_instructions"."account_number" is not null)

invoices_number_once_ready.name: invoices_number_once_ready
invoices_number_once_ready.value:
("invoices"."status" = 'draft') = ("invoices"."sequence_number" is null)
        and ("invoices"."status" = 'draft' or "invoices"."invoice_number" is not null)

support_cases_resolved_fields.name: support_cases_resolved_fields
support_cases_resolved_fields.value:
("support_cases"."status" = 'resolved') = ("support_cases"."resolved_at" is not null and "support_cases"."resolution" is not null)
        and ("support_cases"."status" = 'resolved' or ("support_cases"."resolved_at" is null and "support_cases"."resolution" is null))
